subject: Quick check on the order
text: Hi there, sorry to ping you again so soon, but I wanted to check where things stand with the purchase we made last week. I know you are buried with requisitions too, so I will keep this tiny. My main worry is delivery timing because the small office space still looks bare, and if the chairs do not land by Thursday I will be scrambling. What I did not expect, though, is how quickly everything actually moved once procurement approved the invoice. The vendor sent a confirmation this morning, and apparently the warehouse upgraded our shipment to a faster dispatch route after noticing the address was close to a regional hub. That sounds almost too easy, but it did include a small discount for the delay, which I have already forwarded to finance. If there is anything missing from my side, please say so early enough that I can fix it today rather than Monday. I do not need a full explanation, just a line telling me the likely arrival window, whether tracking has been generated, and whether anyone still needs my confirmation for assembly. Thanks, and apologies for sending this at an awkward hour. No need to chase the driver, I can sign if the building opens.
